by: gazette office readers (fork for 'do it', 2 November 2026)
title: A judge, magistrate or commissioner appointed (Gazette go, vr; titled '… Judge Appointed', '… Commissioner Appointment')

landmarks: a notice under go or vr whose title names Judge(s), Magistrate(s) or Commissioner(s) and ends 'Appointed' or 'Appointment'

signals_note: Never a title the appointment profile takes ('Appointment…'); that profile reads first.
notes: Free prose. The appointee as the appointment reader cuts them; the role is the office given ('to be an Acting District Court Judge', 'as a District Court Judge'), never an earlier description ('District Court Judge, to retire on …') and never 'as the Chief District Court Judge may fix'. Body = the court from the title. Term from/to where printed.
gates: Every recognised notice gives an appointee or is a catch-log line.
Where an appointee lives or worked is never kept.
on_fail: set aside the part or the notice; publish the rest

by: gazette office readers (fork for 'do it', 2 November 2026)
title: A list of Justices of the Peace appointed, retired or resigned (Gazette go, vr)

landmarks: a notice under go or vr titled 'Justices of the Peace Appointed', 'Justices of the Peace (Retired)' or 'Justices of the Peace Resignation(s)', a corrigendum of one

signals_note: The title alone decides; the kind comes from it.
notes: A list after 'Justices of the Peace for New Zealand:', '(retired):', 'the following persons …:' or 'noted for information that', ending at 'Dated at' or 'have resigned'. Appointed entries 'Surname, Given, <address>, <town>.'; retired and resigned entries 'Name, of <town>'. Only the locality is kept: the last comma part, at most four words, no digit, no street word, nothing the lane's address cut finds; else no locality. Names run together with no separator are a catch-log line.
process: Keep the name; keep the town only if it is no street.
gates: Every recognised notice gives an entry or is a catch-log line.
A street address is never kept.
on_fail: set aside the part or the notice; publish the rest

by: gazette office readers (fork for 'do it', 2 November 2026)
title: A Director of Area Mental Health Services appointed (Gazette go)

landmarks: a notice under go whose title names 'Director(s) of Area Mental Health Services'

notes: 'Appoint NAME as Director of Area Mental Health Services in respect of …', or an amendment 'substituting the name and title "Name, title, of Place"' (the name is the first part). The area is the last 'in respect of' before. A principal notice's schedule is not read: a catch-log line.
process: Read each named director and area.
gates: Every recognised notice gives a director or is a catch-log line.
A title or place after the name is never kept.
on_fail: set aside the part or the notice; publish the rest

title: A body appointed to control and manage a reserve, or that appointment revoked (Gazette ln)

landmarks: a notice under ln whose title holds 'appoint' and whose text holds 'to control and manage'

signals_note: The text confirms what the title suggests.
notes: 'appoints the <BODY> to control and manage', or 'revokes the appointment of the <BODY> to control and manage'. The body holds no digit and at most sixteen words. The land is never read.
process: Read the body and the action.
gates: Every recognised notice gives a body or is a catch-log line.
on_fail: set aside the part or the notice; publish the rest

by: gazette office readers (fork for 'do it', 2 November 2026)
title: A school board put under a limited statutory manager, or dissolved for a commissioner; a direction revoked or amended (Gazette go)

landmarks: a notice under go whose title names 'Limited Statutory Manager' or 'Dissolution of … Board … Commissioner', not titled 'Appointment…'

notes: The action from the title (directed, revoked, amended, dissolved). The board from the text ('for the <School> Board', 'Board of Trustees of <School>'), else the title; the institution number in brackets; the statute section; the date; the signature 'NAME, office'; any 'Notice No. YYYY-goNNNN' it names. A revocation marks the direction it names revoked.
process: Read action, board, number, statute, date, signer, notices named.
gates: Every recognised notice gives a board or is a catch-log line.
on_fail: set aside the part or the notice; publish the rest
